b: User RinoLetsPlay has released a new version of Call to Power 2 with many improvements called ctp2-redux. Unlike a lot of the rapid AI disassembly projects we’re seeing atm this new project is built from the already publicly and freely available CTP2 Apolyton Edition source code and brings Activision’s classic 2000 4X strategy game up to date for modern PCs, with a native 64-bit Windows build, sharp 4K display scaling, optional HD upscaling of graphics and videos, and direct-IP multiplayer. ctp2-redux requires you to have either the original CD or the GoG version (Steam version is untested but hopefully that works too) to work. Check out our forum thread for more information.
